claim: The one-click demo shows Northstar Payroll, a landmark, a pinned sample control, and the current task step in the first phone screen; its guide does not operate the sample app.
sandbox: Fresh 390 × 844 browser context at /demo/; assert the landmark, pinned control, and current task step intersect the first viewport, then advance and speak while a click sentinel stays unchanged.

claim: Demo changes use only the demo namespace, reset to the bundled sample, and are discarded by Start for real.
sandbox: Fresh browser context through ?demo=1; inspect all localStorage keys, mutate, reset, exit, and inspect storage again.

claim: Sample landmark placement works by pointer or keyboard; Arrow moves 1%, Shift+Arrow moves 5%, Enter saves, and Escape cancels.
sandbox: Fresh /demo/ state; measure stored coordinates after keyboard and pointer placement, then prove cancellation leaves them unchanged.

claim: The public site and complete sample flow make no third-party requests.
sandbox: Intercept every request across demo placement, guide advance, reset, and Start for real; allow only the served site origin.

claim: The extension does not send notebook data to us or a third party.
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile; create a uniquely named notebook, capture and guide on app.test, then intercept every HTTP request and inspect local extension storage.

claim: The built Chrome extension opens its notebook editor and accessible dialogs from a fresh profile.
where: Landing download section, README installation steps
sandbox: Build the production MV3 directory, load it alone in a fresh Chromium profile, open the editor, and exercise its dialogs.

claim: Capture and guide actions run only on the notebook's exact website, not a look-alike address.
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile with app.test and app.test.evil; assert capture and guide appear only on the exact website.

claim: Notebook data uses one extension-storage key, keeps only the website address, and can be deleted in the editor.
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile; create a notebook from a path URL, inspect all extension storage, then delete it and inspect storage again.

claim: A screenshot exists only while landmark placement is open and is neither stored nor sent to a remote server.
where: Landing, capture overlay, privacy policy, README
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile; inspect extension state during and after capture, cancel, and intercept all HTTP requests.

claim: Manual placement works with and without browser text suggestions, using pointer or keyboard controls.
where: Landing, capture overlay, privacy policy, README
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile with supported and unsupported TextDetector fixtures; save landmarks in both paths and cancel a third.

claim: The guide shows one task step at a time without inspecting page fields or clicking the website.
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile with an isolated-world password-value getter and click sentinel; advance the guide and assert neither sentinel fires.

where: Landing free section, editor, terms, README
sandbox: Fresh MV3 profile; complete every listed workflow, download a backup, inspect UI, and intercept every HTTP request.
